Carmen V: opened PR #4891 to align audit export docs with SOC2 wording and to replace PII in snippets. Legal flagged 'permanent' wording + raw emails in examples. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4891 please @Priya (legal) and @Becky H for snippet check.

docs-bot: PR 4891 preview ready: https://preview.redwood.ai/docs/pr-4891 · build ok :white_check_mark:

Priya (legal): thanks. prefer 'retention period' instead of 'permanent' or 'indefinite'. examples must avoid exposing emails/phones. add a short callout: 'Customers are responsible for downstream retention and must comply with applicable laws.' Also link to the DPA on the compliance page.

Omar S: ops note  We migrated export timestamps from epoch-ms to RFC3339 last year. Could we add a short migration section showing parsing examples for Ruby and jq/curl? Some customers use Ruby for ETL and we've seen failures. Example snippets: 
```bash
# curl + jq to remove email and keep ISO ts
curl -s "https://export.redwood.ai/ORG/exports/123" | jq 'map(.user_email = null)'
```
```ruby
# Ruby parse RFC3339
require 'time'
iso = '2026-02-03T10:11:12Z'
parsed = Time.iso8601(iso)
```
This should stop a bunch of tickets.

Becky H: For snippets I suggest two small patterns: (1) show a pseudonymized row for docs (user_id: 'anon-42'), (2) include a tiny redaction util in Ruby and a one-liner jq example, and (3) mention default CLI export redaction behavior. I'll prepare edits.

Carmen V: Proposed top paragraph: "By default, audit exports redact personal identifiers; customers may configure retention periods per their plan. For extended retention or legal holds, contact support."

Priya (legal): tweak: 'personal identifiers (e.g., email, phone)'. also add: 'Customers must store exported logs in accordance with applicable laws and their internal policies.' Good to add the DPA link.

Becky H: I'll push a commit that: 1) replaces 'permanent' language, 2) swaps sample rows to pseudonyms, 3) adds Ruby and jq parse/redaction examples, 4) creates /guides/migration/exports-timestamp-format.md, and 5) fixes the broken anchor in /guides/index.md. Example redaction helper in Ruby I'll drop in: 
```ruby
# simple redaction helper
def redact(record)
  record['user_email'] = nil
  record['user_phone'] = nil
  record['user_id'] = "anon-#{record['user_id'].to_s[-4..-1]}"
  record
end
```
And a jq one-liner: `jq 'map(.user_email=null, .user_phone=null)'`

Omar S: tiny nit: ensure the migration note clearly lists 'what changed' (epoch-ms -> RFC3339) and sample parsers. add a short troubleshooting bullet for naive integer-parsing code.

Carmen V: Merge checklist: 1) legal phrasing done, 2) docs examples pseudonymized, 3) migration page added, 4) anchors fixed, 5) preview validated. I'll merge once Becky pushes and Priya signs off. :thumbsup:
